visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a Shiba Inu named Nana lying comfortably on her back on a bed. This is followed by a shot of her sleeping peacefully on a rug indoors, with two cats resting nearby in cardboard boxes by a glass door. The lighting is bright and natural. (2) Nana is shown outdoors in a park, running energetically on a grassy field while on a leash. She visits a zoo or farm, looking through a fence at some goats. A sequence of her looking at a pond with birds and standing on a beach is shown, followed by a wide shot of her at a hot air balloon festival and walking across a high glass bridge. (3) Indoors, Nana plays with her owner's hands on a bed, performing 'shake.' She is then shown using an avocado-themed puzzle feeder on a tiled floor. This is followed by a scene of Nana swimming in a pool while wearing a red dog life jacket. (4) Nana is seen drinking from an automatic pet water fountain. The focus then shifts to Royal Canin dog food packaging. Hands are seen mixing dry kibble with wet food from a pouch in a white bowl. Nana then eats the mixture from a bowl on the floor. (5) A young man is seen in a pet store ('Eastern Pet') holding the dog food packages. He is seen sitting next to Nana, demonstrating the product. Graphic overlays show promotional prices and 'Buy 1 Get 6' deals. The video ends with a shot of the man and Nana interacting warmly.
